scope: Serialize HLS cleanup reservation with route activation, block legacy activation in PostgreSQL, and retry object deletion through DurableJob.

checks.name: postgres-integration
checks.command: DATABASE_URL=<disposable-PostgreSQL-17> DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED=<same> npx prisma migrate deploy && npx vitest run --config vitest.postgres.config.ts tests/postgres/video-asset-cleanup-race.pg.test.ts tests/postgres/finalize-audit-boundary.pg.test.ts tests/postgres/encode-attempt-fencing.pg.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=postgres-vitest.json

design.cleanupReservation: Video.cleanupPendingAt set under Video FOR UPDATE; active draft route disabled in same transaction; queue insert and reservation audit are atomic.
design.legacyActivationGuard: PostgreSQL BEFORE trigger locks Video then VideoAsset and rejects ACTIVE routes to cleanup-reserved assets, including callers using older application code.
design.storageRetry: Durable VIDEO_ASSET_CLEANUP deletes R2 outside DB transaction; asset row and completion audit are removed only after successful idempotent prefix deletion.

limits: No Cloudflare R2/S3 sandbox; storage failures and partial deletion are controlled fakes.
No full production rollout or old-process drain was performed; migration documentation requires older processes to be drained before enabling deletion requests.
K19 remains partially verified pending independent review and provider-backed storage acceptance.
